en: I guide Champions to the great battle facilities of the regions, and back here whenever they like.
Where would you like to go?
Sinnoh's Battle Frontier it is. Follow me, and keep close.
{player} followed the guide to Sinnoh's Battle Frontier...
Hoenn's Battle Frontier island it is. Follow me, and keep close.
{player} followed the guide to Hoenn's Battle Frontier...
Unova's Gear Station it is. Follow me, and keep close.
{player} followed the guide to Unova's Gear Station...
I'm sorry, I can only take Champions of that region. Come back once you've entered its Hall of Fame.
Take your time. I'll be at this desk whenever you'd like to go.
